ranged_attack.name: Arcane Bolt
ranged_attack.windup: plants her feet and draws both hands to her chest toward {target}, a glowing violet orb with rings of tiny runes forming between her palms
ranged_attack.release: pushes both palms out and the orb launches as a blazing violet arcane bolt with a white core
ranged_attack.travel: the bolt streaks across the courtyard as a bright violet line trailing sparkling runes of light
ranged_attack.impact: it bursts against {target} in a sharp violet flash and a ring of glowing silver runes
ranged_attack.decay: the runes and violet light vanish in an instant, leaving {target} clear
ranged_attack.again: pushes her palms out again and fires another blazing violet bolt that flashes against {target} and vanishes at once
ranged_attack.text: gathers a violet orb between her palms and pushes it out at {target} as a blazing arcane bolt that bursts in a sharp violet flash on it and vanishes at once

melee_attack.name: Arcane Palm
melee_attack.windup: steps in and draws her right hand back to her hip, her palm glowing bright violet
melee_attack.impact: her glowing palm strikes {target} in a sharp burst of violet light and spinning silver runes
melee_attack.decay: the violet light fades at once
melee_attack.recover: lowers her hand as the last glow fades
melee_attack.again: strikes {target} again with a glowing violet palm in a burst of light that fades at once
melee_attack.text: draws her glowing hand back and thrusts her palm into {target} in a sharp burst of violet light that fades at once

dash.name: Blink
dash.text: blinks forward in a flash of violet light, leaving glowing runes behind her
